Fixed one-second sampling with radio batching every minute. Rejected: the thermopile alone draws too much.
Reading the thermopile and sending over the radio every second empties a 3,000 mAh battery in about two months.
Keep the thermopile and the radio off by default; the PIR stays on.
When the PIR fires, power the thermopile and sample once per second for a 60 second window.
If no occupant is classified in the window, drop back to one sample every 10 seconds, then to PIR-only after 5 minutes of empty readings.
Send a radio message only when the count changes, plus a heartbeat every 15 minutes so silence is not mistaken for a dead unit.
